verdict.rationale: Aider is a local CLI and Python-scriptable coding agent that works in your local git repo. It can edit, auto-test (--test-cmd/--auto-test) and run code (/run), but nothing in the evidence shows a hosted cloud agent that builds, tests and demos a feature end-to-end for review. Its one-shot --message scripting is only a building block a user could deploy themselves, and the 'navigator-mode' autonomy is a community add-on, not a first-party cloud capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
